claim: For the learned-avoidance ODE of Poulton and Ellner (2025), the published statement that all four state variables are uniformly persistent whenever \(R_0>1\) is false on the stated parameter domain. The admitted endpoint \(p=v=0\) makes the avoidance equation \[A'=-[\beta\alpha(P)P+w+\mu+c(P)]A.\] Hence every interior initial condition with \(A(0)>0\) satisfies \(0<A(t)\le A(0)e^{-\mu t}\to0\), so its distance to the boundary face \(A=0\) tends to zero and full-state uniform persistence is impossible. Moreover, the face \(A=0\) is invariant. Whenever \(R_0>1\), that face contains the positive-disease equilibrium \[A^*=0,\qquad S^*=R_0^{-1},\qquad I^*=\frac{\mu(1-R_0^{-1})}{\mu+\phi},\qquad P^*=\frac{\theta}{\lambda}I^*.\] Thus the disease-free equilibrium is not the maximal invariant set on the boundary at \(p=v=0\), contrary to the key boundary step in the supplementary persistence proof. This counterexample refutes only the stronger all-state uniform-persistence statement and its full-boundary proof; it does not establish failure of uniform persistence of the disease variables \(I\) and \(P\) on a suitably reduced state space.
integrity: The learned-avoidance equations, parameter ranges, reproduction number, full-state persistence statement, and the boundary argument in Supplementary Section S1.5 were inspected in the primary article and supplement.
The boundary endemic equilibrium and decay estimate are direct consequences of the printed ODEs and are reproduced by exact arithmetic in verify.py.
Targeted searches for the exact endpoint, persistence claim, and boundary-inflow expression located no published scientific correction of this issue.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample refutes the stronger all-state uniform-persistence statement and its full-boundary proof; it does not show that the disease variables fail to be uniformly persistent on a reduced state space.

The argument establishes that excluding the simultaneous endpoint p=v=0 is necessary for the strict avoidance-inflow step, but does not claim that p+v>0 alone suffices for every remaining persistence hypothesis.
The counterexample concerns the stated mathematical parameter domain, not the parameter choices used in the article’s numerical simulations.
title: The zero-inflow avoidance face invalidates full uniform persistence
